serialization.notes: The custom payload was deserialized to reconstruct each reported matrix; tensor names, dtypes, shapes, scales, angles and residual coefficients are serialized. Exact deterministic roundtrip is tested.

notes: Development seeds 16001 and 16002 passed the preregistered 1.10x activation-MSE and 0.65x byte gates before fresh access.
Fresh seeds 16011, 16012 and 16013 had shared-residual Mirror MSE ratios 1.106, 0.982 and 0.976 to independent int4. The first seed misses the strict all-seed 1.10 gate; no gate pass is claimed.
Shared-residual payload was 393B versus 607B independent int4, including all declared inference state. The actual-byte ratio is 0.647.
Independent-role condition is a misspecification diagnostic; shared Mirror quality degrades sharply while private int4 residuals recover quality at higher bytes.
The result is synthetic fixed-weight evidence with zero optimizer updates; no language-model capacity claim is made.
